Prices and availability may appear only through an Amazon-served link or Creators API/PA-API data. Non-image data can be cached for up to 24 h, and pricing refreshed less often than hourly needs a date/time stamp. Special Links are banned offline and in e-books or printed material. Email and DMs are allowed only to recipients who opted in.
